reason: 该插件的主要用户价值在于本地 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发管理：通过设置面板扫描本地候选项目、让用户主动加入/移出开发管理，并结合宿主工作区会话提供继续开发与上传/更新讨论入口。其功能定位与插件开发流程工具高度一致，未显示通用研究、搜索、教学或媒体处理为主功能，因此分类为 plugin-development。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 本地插件开发管理面板，支持按路径登记本地 file:/link: 插件项目、打开源码目录，并通过确认式会话继续开发或触发 GitHub 上传/更新流程。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web settings panel for local plugin development, allowing manual registration of local file-/link-based plugin projects, opening source folders, and starting confirmation-based sessions for continue-development or GitHub upload/update workflows.

capabilities: local discovery of candidate plugins from package manifests
manual registration and removal of plugin projects
opening project source locations through host workspace/filesystem integration
facilitating workspace sessions for continue-development and GitHub upload/update workflows
storing plugin-management state in local plugin-dev config
